summary: Approvals at scale: Team Approvals and Balance Overrides with filters and paging
description: Team Approvals (manager) and Balance Overrides (HR) work with many requests, in the style of the Leave Policies page: a Pending and Decided view for managers, a Waiting and Overridden view for HR (links, not panels); a name search, leave type, leave dates (a request matches when its dates overlap the range), a status filter for managers (can approve, waiting for HR override, needs a balance fix; approved, rejected, HR override) and a team filter for HR; sorting (HR also by biggest shortfall), page sizes 25, 50 and 100 and a numbered pager; three tiles per view; a table from xl and the original cards below. The scope stays in the SQL (a manager sees only direct reports; HR's queue keeps exactly the conditions of the override route and the dashboard count) and the decision flows, the over-balance rule and the override rules are unchanged. The old cap of 50 on the HR queue is gone. No bulk approve (decided with the user on 2026-10-20). No migration. Shared pieces (pager, tiles, filter form, view tabs, sort header) are extracted from Leave Policies.

summary: Shared list pieces and address parsing
description: src/components/ui/: pager, stat-tiles, list-filters (select, form, search, collapsible selects, chips), view-tabs, sort-header, extracted from Leave Policies; src/lib/leave/list-query.ts, team-queue-schema.ts and override-list-schema.ts parse the address (a bad value is ignored and named; sort is a fixed list per view).
acceptance_criteria: 1. Leave Policies behaves exactly as before on the shared pieces. 2. Every address value is validated on its own and a bad one is ignored with a notice. 3. A status or sort of the other view is ignored.

summary: Reads for the manager and HR pages
description: team-lists.ts (getTeamQueuePage, getTeamDecidedPage, getTeamChoices) and override-lists.ts (getOverrideQueuePage, getOverriddenPage, getOverrideChoices): one statement each, scope and role checked in the SQL, filters bound as values, the order a CASE over validated values, a stable tie-break, the total counted before the cut and the page clamped. Working days and the over-balance state are computed in SQL and mirror checkOverBalance.
acceptance_criteria: 1. A manager sees only their direct reports under any filter, sort or page. 2. The SQL balance state agrees with checkOverBalance for every case. 3. Unfiltered, the HR waiting total equals getOverrideCount. 4. Summaries ignore the filters. 5. An employee, a manager (on the HR lists) and an unknown viewer get nothing.

summary: Team Approvals and Balance Overrides pages
description: Tabs (views), tiles, a search and filter card (name, leave type, status or team, leave dates, sort, rows per page, chips), a table from xl (employee, dates with the reason beneath, submitted, status, actions) and the original cards below, with the numbered pager. The decision buttons are the existing client component. Two statements per page view.
acceptance_criteria: 1. A manager can search, filter, sort and page their pending and decided requests; HR the waiting and overridden ones, with every waiting request reachable. 2. Approve, Reject and Approve override work from a filtered and paged list and the list updates. 3. Labels, 44px targets, keyboard use, no horizontal scroll at 375 and 320 px. 4. Employees and the wrong role are still refused.

summary: Approvals at scale: end-to-end and validation
description: Gated real-database tests, mutation proofs, a browser check as manager and HR at 1728, 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 375 and 320 px with hundreds of requests, a load check with EXPLAIN, the quality gate and a retro.
acceptance_criteria: 1. The AC of TASK-075 to 077 hold on a real engine. 2. The browser check passes. 3. The reads stay fast with thousands of pending requests and the figures are recorded. 4. The quality gate passes.
